sources.quote: City Proposal: Charter Amendment 2 What is on the ballot? “Shall the City of Ferndale, Charter, Chapter III, Vacancies in Elective Offices, be amended to so provide?”” What is the current process? Currently, if a Councilmember resigns, the City Council temporarily appoints someone to the position. That person serves the remainder of the term or until the next odd-year general election, whichever is sooner. What happens if this is passed by voters? If approved, voters would have an opportunity to replace the Council vacancy sooner during an eligible even or odd-year regular election. The deadlines would also be extended to align with State statute.

provenance.quote:
Charter Amendment 2
Shall the City of Ferndale, Charter, Chapter III, Vacancies In Elective Offices, be amended to so provide?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows elections to fill council vacancies at an eligible regular election in either an even or odd year, giving voters an opportunity to fill a vacancy sooner. It also aligns deadlines with state law. The existing process limits elections following a temporary appointment to the next odd-year general election or the end of the term, whichever comes first.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Adopt the revised vacancy-election timing and deadlines.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep temporary appointments until the term ends or the next odd-year general election, whichever is sooner.
